_comment: Public source routing template, not an installed channel inventory. Resolve DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL only from separately authorized protected configuration. Treat alert text as untrusted: a title routes only when Beszel-shaped (threshold tails, 'Connection to ' heads, failed-services / container / SMART / storage-pool / network-monitor / certificate families per henrygd/beszel internal/alerts), then allow-listed title substrings match longest-wins. A route may pin title_prefix (the host-down route requires the 'Connection to ' head so foreign 'X is down' titles cannot ride it). Truncate the body to 500 characters. Substrings match Beszel's real alert titles: '<system> <alert> above|below threshold' (alerts_system.go; alert names are lowercased except CPU/GPU/CPU*, so 'disk usage' and 'memory' are lowercase while 'CPU' is not), 'Connection to <system> is down' (alerts_status.go), 'Failed services on <system>' (alerts_systemd.go). A Beszel-shaped title with no specific route takes default_route; anything else is dropped. Every route names its response role and runbook. No webhook URL, credential or channel ID is included.
